This '''RA-7 protocol droid''' was an [[Information broker/Legends|information specialist]] which operated undercover as a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] aboard the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The ''Empire''...?! But that could lead them to the ''twins''!''"<br />"''What's that?''"<br />"''Erm&hellip; nothing. I'm merely babbling in incoherent terror. Please ignore me.''"<br />"''If you'd shut up, I'd be happy to.|C-3PO and the RA-7 protocol droid|<ref name="Memory Loss" />}}
[[File:C-3PO_memroy_wipe_2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] wipes the RA-7's memory and his own to protect [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] children]]
By the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] had spent some time aboard [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] personal [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']]. Following the advice of a partner, this [[Information broker/Legends|information specialist]] acted as a servile [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] aboard the [[CR70 corvette/Legends|CR70 corvette]] in hopes of learning valuable information to sell.<ref name="Memory Loss" />

When Organa entrusted [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], he ordered him to have the protocol droid's mind [[Memory wipe/Legends|wiped]]. Walking them to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] workshop of the ''Sundered Heart'', Antilles charged the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] with the task before returning to the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]].<ref name="Memory Loss" />

Lurking in a dark corner of the droid workshop, the RA-7 overheard the chatty [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO unit]] bragging about top secret information stored in his [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]]. Seizing the opportunity, the RA-7 [[Skirmish aboard the Sundered Heart|attacked]] the two droids. The RA-7 immobilized R2-D2 with an [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blaster]] and threatened C-3PO to remove his memory banks with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. Realizing that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] could learn the locations of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], C-3PO willingly wiped his own memory, taking the RA-7 along with him. When C-3PO woke up from the memory wipe, R2-D2 had already awaken from the ion blast and had dissembled the RA-7 protocol droid.<ref name="Memory Loss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You just don't know when to keep quiet, do you, ''Goldie''? Now hold still while I ''remove'' your sweet, bulging ''memory banks''!|The RA-7 protocol droid, to C-3PO|<ref name="Memory Loss" />}}
[[File:Unidentified_RA-7_protocol_droid_Sundered_Heart_2.jpg|thumb|right|125px|[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] throws away the RA-7's dissembled body]]
This [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] was able to keep a low profile, as it had spent some time undercover aboard the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], keeping his true nature a secret. As a result, it despised [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] for being overly chatty. It was greedy for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], being qualified as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] by C-3PO. The RA-7 could wield a [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blaster]] and a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], but was caught by surprise when C-3PO grabbed him and [[Memory wipe/Legends|wiped]] both of their memories.<ref name="Memory Loss" />

==Behind the scenes==
This [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] first appeared in ''[[Memory Loss]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] written by [[Christopher Cooper]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]], which was published in [[2014]] in ''[[Star Wars Comic 7.13]]''.
